note: Design target curves for the curve-sweep check (Part 1). Rule 0: design documents only, no plant trend or snapshot. x = load. FHI curves use boiler load % MCR = main steam flow / 460 T/H; HB cases use generator load % = MW / 150. 'repo' = the points are written in this repository (file given); 'pc' = the curve exists in the document but its points are not in the repository yet and must be read on the PC. Points between two printed points: straight line. No extrapolation outside the printed range: below the first point the curve is NOT a target.
